phase6Decisions.decision: Professional document requests use document_requests rows as the single source for additional request containers.
A client-visible request from an attorney or bond originator appears to the targeted client party, the agent, the requester role, attorneys, and internal users.
Shared role-player requests stay out of buyer/seller portals unless explicitly targeted to a client party.

warnings.message: Professional request propagation depends on the document_requests table being present in the target environment.
